name: OCI ZPR Visibility
description: Dashboard query catalog for OCI ZPR posture, policy inventory, protected resources, allow/block traffic, and governance findings.

widgets.name: KPI: Active policies
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats distinctcount(policy_id) as policies

widgets.name: KPI: Protected resources
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as resources

widgets.name: KPI: Critical+High findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and severity in ('CRITICAL', 'HIGH') | stats count as high_findings
ask_ai_prompts: List the open CRITICAL and HIGH findings and their resources.

widgets.name: KPI: Blocked flows
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' | stats count as blocked_flows

widgets.name: KPI: Unexpected accepted
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'unexpected_accepted' | stats count as unexpected

widgets.name: Active ZPR policies
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats distinctcount(policy_id) as active_policies by policy_lifecycle_state

widgets.name: Protected resources
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats distinctcount(resource_id) as protected_resources by resource_type

widgets.name: Top findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' | stats count as findings by severity, finding_type | sort -findings
ask_ai_prompts: Which finding types and severities dominate, and which resources drive them?

widgets.name: Policy statement table
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | fields policy_name, policy_lifecycle_state, source_attribute, destination_attribute, network_scope, target_type, statement

widgets.name: Source destination matrix
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats count as rules by source_attribute, destination_attribute

widgets.name: Broad CIDR exceptions
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | fields severity, policy_name, cidr, recommendation
ask_ai_prompts: Which policies allow overly broad CIDR ranges?

widgets.name: Policy relationship sunburst
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_statement' | stats count as rules by source_attribute, destination_attribute

widgets.name: Resources by attribute
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats count as resources by security_attributes

widgets.name: Resources by subnet
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | stats count as resources by subnet_id, resource_type

widgets.name: Resource detail
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_resource' | fields resource_name, resource_type, private_ip, subnet_id, security_attributes

widgets.name: Enriched ACCEPT vs REJECT
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | stats count as flows by action, classification
ask_ai_prompts: Break down flows by action and classification over time.

widgets.name: Rejected protected destinations
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | fields source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol
ask_ai_prompts: Which rejected flows targeted ZPR-protected destinations?

widgets.name: Unexpected accepted flows
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'unexpected_accepted' | fields source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol
ask_ai_prompts: Which accepted flows lack an expected ZPR policy?

widgets.name: Flow path link (src to dst)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' | fields source_resource_name, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, classification
ask_ai_prompts: Trace flows from source to destination by classification.

widgets.name: Policy drift candidates
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_drift' | fields policy_id, statement, old_hash, new_hash

widgets.name: Missing policy findings
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'protected_resource_no_matching_policy' | fields severity, resource_name, resource_type, security_attributes, recommendation
ask_ai_prompts: Which protected resources have no matching ZPR policy?

widgets.name: DET: Over-permissive flows
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'unexpected_accepted' | stats count as over_permissive

widgets.name: DET: Suspected misconfig
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'suspected_misconfiguration' | stats count as suspected_misconfig

widgets.name: DET: Blocked to protected
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and action = 'REJECT' and zpr_destination = true | stats count as blocked_to_protected

widgets.name: DET: Broad CIDR exceptions
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | stats count as broad_cidr

widgets.name: Detection: over-permissive flows (ZPR-Over-Permissive)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'unexpected_accepted' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Over-Permissive' | fields Detection, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol

widgets.name: Detection: suspected misconfiguration (ZPR-Suspected-Misconfig)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_enriched_flow' and classification = 'suspected_misconfiguration' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Suspected-Misconfig' | fields Detection, source_resource_name, source_ip, destination_resource_name, destination_ip, destination_port, protocol

widgets.name: Detection: broad CIDR exceptions (ZPR-Broad-CIDR)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_finding' and finding_type = 'broad_cidr_exception' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Broad-CIDR' | fields Detection, severity, policy_name, cidr, recommendation

widgets.name: Detection: policy drift (ZPR-Policy-Drift)
widgets.query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI ZPR Visibility JSON' | where record_type = 'zpr_policy_drift' | eval Detection = 'ZPR-Policy-Drift' | fields Detection, policy_id, statement, old_hash, new_hash
